name: smwmusic-zelda-ii-the-adventure-of-link-final-boss
title: Zelda II: The Adventure of Link - Final Boss
description:
An 8-bit port of the music used for Dark Link in Zelda 2.
Super short yet still manages to be intense. Good for your boss battles.

Back up (again) with removal reasons fixed, mainly some accuracy issues and not including the SMW samples.

Shoutouts to Maxodex and Nameless.
